report_metadata.sdlc_rationale: All four PREDICTIVE conditions met: requirements fully defined and signed off by CFO/IT/Finance; team has direct stack experience (React, Node.js, Azure AD integration); no scope changes expected (out-of-scope explicitly agreed); fixed 10-week deadline tied to Q3 payroll cycle.

project_understanding.primary_goal: Build an internal web application to replace Google Sheets-based expense reporting, enabling employees to submit claims, managers to approve/reject, and Finance to export monthly CSV for reimbursement processing.
project_understanding.trigger: Current Google Sheets process causes concurrent-edit data loss and has resulted in two payroll errors last quarter; CFO has approved budget and mandated IT ownership.
success_definition: Employees can submit an expense claim in under 2 minutes
Managers can approve/reject with one click from email notification
Finance can export the full monthly report as CSV without manual aggregation
supporting_quotes: The Google Sheets process breaks down when more than 3 people edit simultaneously, causing data loss.
We had two payroll errors last quarter from corrupted expense data.
CFO has approved budget and asked IT to own the solution.
10 weeks from project kickoff (firm, tied to Q3 payroll cycle start)

hard.deadline: 10 weeks from kickoff (Q3 payroll cycle start)
hard.team_composition: 1 PM/Product Owner (50% internal), 1 Full-Stack Developer (100% internal, contractor backup available), 1 QA Analyst (50% internal)
hard.technology_stack: Frontend: React + TypeScript; Backend: Node.js + PostgreSQL; Auth: Azure AD SSO (existing library); Hosting: Azure App Service; Email: SendGrid
hard.compliance: Standard internal security policy (pre-approved by IT Security); 7-year data retention per company accounting policy (pre-approved by Legal); Azure Blob Storage encryption-at-rest (identical to HR portal already in production)

soft.preferred_tools: Follow existing internal UI component library for visual consistency

nfr.security: Azure AD SSO authentication; Azure Blob Storage encryption-at-rest (existing company standard); no PII beyond employee names and reimbursement amounts; no external data sharing
nfr.data_retention: Expense records and receipt images retained for 7 years per company accounting policy (pre-approved, no new review required)

open_questions_pre_planning.question: Who is the Product Owner responsible for backlog prioritization during execution?
open_questions_pre_planning.impact_if_unanswered: Scope creep or decision delays if PM's authority to make trade-off decisions is not formally confirmed with CFO/IT Manager during kickoff.
